title: Healthcare & Life Sciences Regulatory Rulepack
mandatorySecurityControls: PHI Encryption at Rest (AES-256-GCM) and Transit (TLS 1.3)

rules.title: Protected Health Information (PHI) Encryption Mandatory
rules.description: All PHI payloads stored in persistent tables or transmitted across networks must be encrypted using AES-256-GCM and TLS 1.3.

rules.title: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Signature & Audit Compliance
rules.description: Electronic records and signatures must contain timestamp, signer identity, purpose, and tamper-evident hash links.

rules.title: Automated Safe Harbor PHI De-Identification
rules.description: Non-clinical data streams, logs, and analytics pipelines must automatically strip 18 HIPAA identifier categories.

rules.title: Minimum Necessary Access & Role-Based Authorization
rules.description: Access to patient medical records must strictly conform to minimum necessary access permissions based on verified practitioner role.

rules.title: GxP Software Validation & Verification Evidence
rules.description: Software deployments in clinical environments require automated verification test runs and GxP validation certificates.
